text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And my favorite scene in this volume is when the protagonist faces the enemy champion in a gallant duel. It's truly riveting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree. Personally, I was
very pleased
with the way this volume
incorporated aspects of
real-world
mythology.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's important to note that it delves into
rather
realistic concepts, despite being a
work of fiction.
The training methods are
quite feasible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the library to find Zenno Rob
Roy,
Mejiro Ardan, and Biwa Hayahide
having a
discussion in hushed tones.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello. I'm sorry—were we being too
loud?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We're sharing our impressions of the
latest
volume in this novel series. It's a
very intriguing
book...
choice_data_list: I'm fine. What were you guys talking about?
I'm fine. What were you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's simply amazing! I could talk about it forever!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's a slight problem however. There
aren't
many others with whom we can
discuss the latest
volume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's... absolutely correct. We've found

ourselves unable to fully express all the
passion
we feel towards this book.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's such a shame...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the book's a hidden gem? In that
case, I
can see why they'd feel
disheartened about not
having enough
people to discuss it with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the book's a hidden gem? In that
case, I
can see why they'd feel
disheartened about not
having enough
people to discuss it with.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give that novel a read too.
Maybe I'll read that novel too.
Can you tell me what you like best about that book?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give that novel a read too.
Maybe I'll read that novel too.
Can you tell me what you like best about that book?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All of their eyes seem to light up at that
instant.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-you really mean it?! I'm so happy to
hear that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Your thoughtfulness is much
appreciated. Hehe,
how wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I believe this library has every volume in
the
series. I'll fetch them right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, even Hayahide is enthused.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three Umamusume are delighted by
my
decision. They really are passionate
about books.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having the opportunity to assist them
fills my own
heart with joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though for some reason, I can't help but
feel this
joy might be short-lived...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...And that's volume thirty-four. This is
the entire
series of books, including the
latest volume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In front of Hayahide looms what can
only be
described as a mountain of
books!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's also a spin-off series that
comprises
twelve volumes. I'll go and
retrieve those, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait, Hayahide. Could you bring
along the
series guide as well?
choice_data_list: There's going to be even more...?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wow, volume six brings back so many
memories! I
loved the hero's training arc!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should read all the previous
volumes
again. I might discover new
details or gain a
different perspective on
things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've heard of this series, but I had no
idea how
insanely long it is.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I think you've caught on. There
aren't
many people to discuss the latest
volume with
because so few people have
read all of the
previous ones.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this is too much to ask of
you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Really?! I'm so thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My pride as a trainer keeps me from
backing
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd walk through fire if it meant putting a
smile on
a student's face!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I stay up late reading every night for a very lengthy period.
choice_data_list: (Read all the volumes! Go for ittt...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not a problem! Are you interested in
reading
the series?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew. We need to dig deep and sell
Trainer on
the books' strong points.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The trio begin their pitch in a somewhat

exuberant manner.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This series follows a protagonist who has
no
special powers on their journey to
becoming a
hero!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The depth of the history and
world-building in
these novels is such
that reading them is like
poring over the
annals of an entire world.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist is so quick-witted that
you end
up impressed with how realistic
and logical the
novels are, especially for
a fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They continue discussing the novels with
palpable
glee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing them so happy fills my own heart
with joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though for some reason, I can't help but
feel this
joy might be short-lived...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And what's more! The series has a wealth
of
foreshadowing! The story is so
painstakingly
crafted!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There are events in volume thirty-two
that were
hinted at as far back as
volume three! Nobody
even realized it
was foreshadowing at the time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I can't go into any more detail
lest I spoil
something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Many of the events borrow heavily from

real-world mythology, so the ideas
presented in
the series are truly worthy
of analysis.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The motifs and symbolism that appear in
the tales
of past events often play into
future
developments in the story, so it's
also fascinating
from a historical point of
view.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I can't go into any more detail
without
spoiling things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
More than an hour has passed, but none
of them
are showing any signs of slowing
down.
choice_data_list: (The passion...! Her energy is off the charts!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gravely underestimated their fervor for
these
books!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, please read up to
volume eight.
Its unique depiction of the
laws of physics within
a fantasy world is
truly brilliant.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I can't go into any more detail or I'll
spoil it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come to think of it, the protagonist's

perspective on the idea of being a hero
in volume
twelve is very compelling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The way volume twenty-one examined
the
historical motifs it depicted was
strikingly
innovative.

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Ardan
text_block_list.text: You will?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That was the only response I could
possibly give...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it's to put a smile on a student's face,
then no
task is too demanding for any
trainer worth their
salt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no choice but to dive right into
the fiery
embrace of their ardent
passion.
